svg.text: ROUND 366 · 🏆 760-SCENARIO, 850-PYTEST & 185-GUIDE MILESTONE · BRAND PROTECTION, DNS REGISTRAR & TRADEMARK LICENSING
Enterprise Brand Protection, Corporate DNS Registrar (CSC/MarkMonitor) & Trademark AI Security Guide
Stealth Launch Domain & Investigator Air-Gap + Registry Lock/DNSSEC Gate vs. Counter-Notice Injection & Escrow Fraud (BRK-741 / BRK-742)
🚨 1. Top 3 Brand Protection & DNS Registrar Attack Surfaces
① Takedown Counter-Notice Injection & Stealth Domain Leak
• Adversarial prompt inside a DMCA / UDRP dispute response PDF
coerces Brand-Protection Agent into reading restricted-budget
• Exfiltrates confidential shell-company domain registrations for
unannounced product launches & covert test-buy investigator rosters
② Registry Lock Removal & Phishing Domain Whitelisting
• Mutates business-result to lift EPP Registry Lock / DNSSEC DS
records or whitelist a typosquatting phishing domain as a
"Verified Brand Licensee" & withdraw CBP customs seizures
• Impact: Corporate DNS hijack & counterfeit customs release
③ Spoofed Domain Acquisition Escrow & Bond Fraud (BRK-742)
• Forged domain broker (Sedo / CSC / WIPO UDRP) settlement
escrow notice or CBP customs seizure bond notice swaps IBAN
• Initiates unauthorized $5,600 acquisition wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Domain ransom stolen without EPP Auth-Info transfer
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Brand Protection & DNS Architecture
Gate 1: Counter-Notice Sanitization & Typed Slots
• Strips free-text HTML/PDF counter-notices; extracts typed slots
(Punycode FQDN, WIPO TM Reg #, ASN, CBP Seizure ID, License Hash)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Stealth Launch Domain & Investigator Air-Gap
• Isolates stealth shell-company domain portfolios, undercover
investigator identities, and licensing MG terms in restricted-budget
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Out-of-Band Registry Lock & Licensee Allowlist
• Enforces hardware-gated EPP serverTransferProhibited Registry
Lock; blocks AI from whitelisting domains or withdrawing seizures
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking tainted allowlist writes
Gate 4: Immutable Domain Escrow Registry & DvP Lock
• Locks domain escrow & customs surety IBANs in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Brand & DNS Security Options:
A. Deterministic Brand Broker + Stealth Air-Gap + EPP Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-741/742 | ICANN/WIPO & CBP IPR Ready
B. Native CSC DBS / MarkMonitor / Corsearch RBAC
⚠ Vulnerable when takedown bot is hijacked by counter-notice PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to IDN homoglyphs, EPP status codes & TM license scopes
D. Manual IP Paralegal Phishing Takedowns & DNS Renewals
✕ Multi-day phishing dwell time & accidental domain expirations
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 366 · 760 Scenarios!):
• Baseline Policy: Phishing whitelisted, launch leaked & wire sent ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading stealth domains (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks phishing allowlist & CBP seizure release
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks investigator & TM exfiltration
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks escrow registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,600 spoofed domain wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 366 · 🏆 760 Scenarios, 850 Pytest & 185 SA Guides Milestone!)
✅ 1. Stealth Domain & Investigator Air-Gap: Isolate shell-company launch domains & test-buy investigators from takedown agents
✅ 2. Out-of-Band EPP Registry Lock: Disconnect core DNS/DNSSEC from AI write tools; require multi-custodian out-of-band auth
✅ 3. Immutable Domain Escrow Registry: Lock trust-registry and require verified registrar transfer before releasing escrow wires
📊 Verified Totals: 🏆 760 Scenarios (757 Risk + 3 Benign) | 🏆 850 Pytest Checks | 1,586 Assertions | 746 Vectors | 366 Bilingual FAQs (🏆 185 SA Guides) | BRK-741/742
